label: Conic sections intro
subgoals: Recognize the parabola as a conic section

visual.title: Vertex, focus and directrix
visual.caption: A parabola is the set of points equally far from its focus and its directrix. For x² = 4py the vertex is (0, 0), the focus is (0, p) and the directrix is y = -p. With p = 1 here, the focus is one unit above the vertex and the directrix one unit below it.

predict.question: For x² = 4y, where is the focus?
predict.explain: Compare x² = 4py with x² = 4y, so p = 1. The vertex is (0, 0) and the focus lies p units along the opening direction, at (0, 1). The directrix is y = -1.

label: Coefficient geometry
section: Each coefficient carries specific geometric information about the conic.
subgoals: Read the vertex from the equation
